question_en: How many of Samsung's TDocs fed into agreements, and what share? (contribution performance)
original_query: MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc) WITH c, count(t) AS totalTdocs OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t2:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c) WITH c, totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT a) AS agreementCount RETURN c.companyName, totalTdocs, agreementCount, round(100.0 * agreementCount / totalTdocs, 1) AS contributionRate
reference_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'})
WITH DISTINCT t
WITH count(t) AS totalTdocs,
     sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) } THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agreementLinkedTdocCount
RETURN agreementLinkedTdocCount,
       {numerator: agreementLinkedTdocCount, denominator: totalTdocs} AS agreementLinkedTdocShare

required_fields.name: agreementLinkedTdocCount
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: count(distinct Samsung Tdoc referenced by at least one typed Agreement)

required_fields.name: agreementLinkedTdocShare
required_fields.source_column_or_expression: exact agreementLinkedTdocCount/count(distinct all retained Samsung Tdoc), encoded as an integer numerator/denominator pair

canonical_encoding.denominator: nonzero integer, sign normalized to positive

allowed_equivalent_encodings: typed finite exact JSON number in units of one
explicit percent object with typed finite exact number
